A fala gerou revolta e foi rebatida pelo deputado Rogério Correia (PT-MG), que subiu à tribuna para defender a democracia e a legalidade do pleito.

Ele lembrou que Lula é recebido como herói internacional por frear o neofascismo e o ultraliberalismo, e cobrou: onde estão Ramagem, Eduardo Bolsonaro e Flávio Bolsonaro, todos foragidos? E os 72 milhões de Vorcaro, que o Novo nunca menciona? Para Correia, o partido não reconhece a vitória de Lula porque nunca quis combater a corrupção de verdade.

snippet.description:
해도해도 너무하네. 진짜

당의 최고위원이
이렇게 계속 사고를 칠 수가 있나?

영상 기자와 사진 기자들을 향해서
하이에나떼 얘기했을 때도
제정신이 아닌 것 같다라는 생각이 들었는데

어제 뉴스로 보니까
도대체 대통령에 대한 험담을
뒤에서 얼마나 하고 다녔느냐.

이런 사람이
당에 최고위원으로 계속 화면에
최고위원 회의할 때마다
당대표 바로 옆에 화면에 잡히고
최고위원 으로써 발언을 이어가는 상황이

이게 민주당에
도대체 얼마나 큰 패로 다가오겠느냐.

그리고 당의 간판 급의 얼굴로
놔둘 수 있겠냐는 의문이 들어요, 기본적으로.

당에 큰 부담이 될 수밖에 없죠.

당에 계신 분으로서
말은 어렵겠지만
윤리감찰 지시했다 그러는데
김민석 대표가

이럴때는 조치의
수준을 어디까지 가져가야 될까요?

적어도
현직 국회의원 이자
정치인으로서 양식이 있는 분이라면

이 상황에서는
최고위원직을 스스로 사퇴하는 게
맞지 않나 싶어요.

최고위원직은 사퇴하고

snippet.title: Pasta Aglio E Olio with Just Me and My Bestie #friendship #bestie #memories #comfortfood #pasta
snippet.description:
Those good old college days! 🥹❤️ They gave me people who, even after 14 years, are still such an important part of my life.

Meet my girl bestie, Kunjika! From studying together to eating together, we’ve shared so many little moments that became our sweetest memories. And our favourite meals have always been a big part of our friendship! 🫶🏻

Today, while visiting her, we got busy gossiping and reminiscing about college. When she asked, “Kya khayega?” I didn’t even have to think—“Aglio e olio pasta!” 🍝😂

Some things never change—our bond, our endless conversations, and our love for good food! ❤️

Here’s the recipe:

🍝 Boil pasta with salt and a little olive oil. Save some pasta water before draining.
🧄 Heat olive oil and butter in a pan. Add sliced garlic and sauté until lightly golden.
🌿 Add mixed herbs, chilli flakes, chopped coriander stems, salt to taste, and a splash of the reserved pasta water.
✨ Toss in the cooked pasta, mix well, and serve hot with garlic bread!

College wali friendship aur favourite food—aur kya chahiye? 🥰

भारतीय टेलीविजन पर पहली रोमांचक खोजी श्रृंखला आज सबसे लोकप्रिय शो में से एक है। नाटकीय और बिल्कुल अप्रत्याशित, सी.आई.डी. पिछले ग्यारह वर्षों में दर्शकों को मंत्रमुग्ध कर दिया है और अपने रोमांचक कथानक और उत्साह से दर्शकों को उनके टेलीविजन सेटों से बांधे रखा है। इसके तेज़-तर्रार कथानकों में सी.आई.डी. की व्यक्तिगत चुनौतियाँ भी गुंथी हुई हैं। टीम को ड्यूटी के नाम पर बिना रुके साहसिक कार्य, जबरदस्त दबाव और जोखिम का सामना करना पड़ता है। श्रृंखला में जांच, पता लगाने और रहस्य से संबंधित कठोर पुलिस प्रक्रियात्मक कहानियां शामिल हैं। धारावाहिक के नायक पुलिस बल के अपराध जांच विभाग से संबंधित पुलिस अधिकारियों का एक विशिष्ट समूह हैं, जिसका नेतृत्व एसीपी प्रद्युम्न कर रहे हैं, जिनकी भूमिका दया और अभिजीत के साथ गतिशील शिवाजी सातम ने निभाई है। हालाँकि कहानियाँ विश्वसनीय हैं, लेकिन इसमें नाटकीय कथानक और पुलिस द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली तकनीकी जटिलताओं पर भी जोर दिया गया है। हर चरण में, कथानक में दिलचस्प मोड़ आते हैं और अधिकारी छोटे-छोटे सुरागों के आधार पर अपराधियों का पता लगाने में सक्रिय रहते हैं।

The first thrilling investigative series on Indian Television is today one of the most popular shows. Dramatic and absolutely unpredictable, C.I.D. has captivated viewers over the last eleven years and continues to keep audiences glued to their television sets with its thrilling plots and excitement. Also interwoven in its fast-paced plots are the personal challenges that the C.I.D. team faces with non-stop adventure, tremendous pressure, and risk, all in the name of duty. The series consists of hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection, and suspense. The protagonists of the serial are an elite group of police officers belonging to the Crime Investigation Department of the police force, led by ACP Pradyuman, played by the dynamic Shivaji Satam along with Daya and Abhijit. While the stories are plausible, there is an emphasis on dramatic plotting and technical complexities faced by the police. At every stage, the plot throws up intriguing twists and turns to keep the officers on the move as they track criminals, led by the smallest of clues.

snippet.title: Butter Chicken Biryani Recipe in Tamil
snippet.description:
In this video we will see how to make Butter Chicken Biryani Recipe in Tamil, a rich, creamy, and flavorful biryani that combines the delicious taste of restaurant-style butter chicken with the aromatic flavors of traditional Indian biryani. This special biryani is made with tender, juicy chicken pieces cooked in a buttery tomato and cashew gravy, layered with fragrant basmati rice, saffron milk, fried onions, and fresh herbs. The combination of creamy butter chicken masala and perfectly cooked biryani rice makes every bite rich, aromatic, and absolutely delicious.

Butter Chicken Biryani is a wonderful fusion of two popular Indian dishes – Butter Chicken and Chicken Biryani. The chicken is marinated with curd, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, Kashmiri chilli powder, green chillies, and kasoori methi to give it a deep and flavorful taste. The gravy is prepared with butter, onions, tomatoes, whole spices, and cashew paste, creating a smooth, creamy, and mildly spicy masala. A touch of sugar balances the tanginess of the tomatoes, while fresh mint and coriander leaves add a refreshing aroma.

The partially cooked basmati rice is layered with the rich butter chicken gravy and topped with saffron milk, fried onions, coriander leaves, mint leaves, and ghee. The final cooking allows the flavors to blend beautifully, creating a delicious biryani with soft, fluffy rice and juicy chicken pieces. This recipe is perfect for weekend lunches, family gatherings, birthday parties, festive celebrations, or whenever you want to prepare a special restaurant-style biryani at home.

Serve this Butter Chicken Biryani hot with onion raita, cucumber raita, boiled eggs, or a simple salad for a complete and satisfying meal. Once you try this homemade Butter Chicken Biryani recipe, it will surely become one of your favorite chicken biryani varieties.

Friends, please do try this Butter Chicken Biryani recipe at home and share it with your friends and family. Also, please share your feedback about the recipe in the comments below. All the best and happy cooking!

Ingredients:  
To marinate Chicken:
3/4 Kg Chicken with bone
2 tbsp thick Curd
1/4 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp Coriander powder
2 tsp Biryani masala or chicken masala
1 tbsp Kashmiri chilli powder or 2 tsp regular chilli powder
1 tbsp Ginger Garlic paste
2 green Chillies
2 tsp Kasoori methi
Salt as required

To Cook Rice:
2 tbsp Oil
2 Bay leaves,2 Cinnamon,3 Cloves,3 Cardamom
Water
Salt
2.5 cup Basmati Rice (500g)

To make Butter Chicken Biryani:
4 tbsp Butter
2 Bay leaves,2 Cinnamon,2 Cloves,2 Cardamom
1 Onion
3 medium Tomatoes
1 tsp Sugar
Coriander & Mint leaves
20 Cashews (paste)
Water as required

Toppings:
2 tbsp Saffron Milk
2-4 tbsp hot water (if required)
Coriander & Mint leaves
Fried onion
2 tbsp Ghee
